records.question: 各客户等级分别有多少客户?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.describe AS 客户等级, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM ads_cust_info_d a JOIN dim_public p ON a.cust_lvl_cd=p.code AND p.code_type_id='100' WHERE a.data_dt='20260531' GROUP BY p.describe ORDER BY 客户数 DESC
records.caliber_notes: 客户等级=dim_public code_type_id=100 解码 cust_lvl_cd;客户表单快照。
records.sql:
SELECT dim_public.describe AS 客户等级, COUNT(ads_cust_info_d.pty_id) AS 客户数
FROM ads_cust_info_d
LEFT JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.cust_lvl_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '100'
WHERE ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531'
GROUP BY dim_public.describe
ORDER BY 客户数 DESC
records.explanation: 按 2026-05-31 快照统计，各客户等级中紫金理财银卡客户最多，为 151 户；其次是金卡客户 118 户、白金卡客户 73 户。另有 65 户未匹配到客户等级（等级为空），紫金理财卡客户 63 户，钻石卡客户最少，为 30 户。等级为空可能是客户等级编码在字典表中无对应记录所致。

records.question: 按年龄段(30 岁以下/30-50/50-60/60 以上)客户分别有多少人?
records.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN cust_age<30 THEN '30岁以下' WHEN cust_age<50 THEN '30-50岁' WHEN cust_age<60 THEN '50-60岁' ELSE '60岁以上' END AS 年龄段, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM ads_cust_info_d WHERE data_dt='20260531' GROUP BY 年龄段 ORDER BY 年龄段
records.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN cust_age < 30 THEN '<30' WHEN cust_age < 50 THEN '[30,50)' WHEN cust_age < 60 THEN '[50,60)' ELSE '≥60' END AS 年龄段, COUNT(pty_id) AS 客户人数 FROM ads_cust_info_d WHERE data_dt = '20260531' GROUP BY 年龄段 ORDER BY 年龄段 ASC
records.explanation: 按 2026-05-31 的客户主档快照统计，客户年龄明显集中在 50 岁以上：50-60 岁有 204 人，60 岁及以上有 262 人，两者合计 466 人，是客户主体。30-50 岁仅 34 人，而 30 岁以下没有客户。整体呈现客户年龄偏大的特征。

records.question: 硕士及以上学历的女性客户有多少人?
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM ads_cust_info_d a JOIN dim_public e ON a.edu_cd=e.code AND e.code_type_id='600' JOIN dim_public g ON a.gender_cd=g.code AND g.code_type_id='500' WHERE a.data_dt='20260531' AND g.describe='女' AND e.describe IN ('硕士','博士')
records.caliber_notes: 硕士及以上=硕士/博士;女性经 500 解码。
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.pty_id) AS 客户人数
FROM ads_cust_info_d a
LEFT JOIN dim_public edu ON a.edu_cd = edu.code AND edu.code_type_id = '600'
LEFT JOIN dim_public gender ON a.gender_cd = gender.code AND gender.code_type_id = '500'
WHERE a.data_dt = '20260531'
  AND gender.describe = '女'
  AND (edu.describe LIKE '%硕士%' OR edu.describe LIKE '%博士%')
records.explanation: 按 2026-05-31 的客户快照统计，硕士及以上学历的女性客户共有 3 人。该结果基于客户主档中性别为"女"、且学历描述包含"硕士"或"博士"的记录去重统计得出。

records.caliber_notes: 一季度=20260101~20260331;一级分类用 up_prdt_type_id+up_prdt_type_name 分组(存在同名多义)。
records.sql: SELECT dim_product.up_prdt_type_id AS 一级分类ID, dim_product.up_prdt_type_name AS 一级分类, SUM(dwd_cust_tran_d.buy_amt) AS 买入金额 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d JOIN dim_product ON dwd_cust_tran_d.prdt_id = dim_product.prdt_id WHERE dwd_cust_tran_d.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY dim_product.up_prdt_type_id, dim_product.up_prdt_type_name ORDER BY 买入金额 DESC

records.question: 2026-03-31 各客户等级客户的总资产分别是多少?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.describe AS 客户等级, ROUND(SUM(s.nm_tot_aset+s.fc_pur_aset),4) AS 总资产 FROM dws_cust_aset_d s JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON s.pty_id=a.pty_id AND a.data_dt='20260531' JOIN dim_public p ON a.cust_lvl_cd=p.code AND p.code_type_id='100' WHERE s.data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY p.describe ORDER BY 总资产 DESC
records.caliber_notes: 资产取 20260331 快照;等级经 100 解码;总资产=nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset。
records.sql:
SELECT dim_public.describe AS 客户等级, SUM(dws_cust_aset_d.nm_tot_aset + dws_cust_aset_d.fc_pur_aset) AS 总资产
FROM dws_cust_aset_d
JOIN ads_cust_info_d ON dws_cust_aset_d.pty_id = ads_cust_info_d.pty_id AND ads_cust_info_d.data_dt = '20260531'
JOIN dim_public ON ads_cust_info_d.cust_lvl_cd = dim_public.code AND dim_public.code_type_id = '100'
WHERE dws_cust_aset_d.data_dt = '20260331'
GROUP BY dim_public.describe
ORDER BY 总资产 DESC
records.explanation: 2026-03-31 各客户等级总资产呈明显的金字塔分布，等级越高资产规模越大。紫金理财钻石卡客户以约 3.75 亿元居首，白金卡客户约 1.41 亿元，金卡客户约 6006 万元，银卡客户约 1936 万元，普通理财卡客户约 141 万元，另有少量等级为空的客户约 13 万元。总资产按"总资产 = nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset"口径计算，客户等级名称取自 dim_public.describe。需注意客户等级信息取自 2026-05-31 快照，与资产统计日 2026-03-31 存在时间差，可能带来等级归属的偏差。

records.question: 2026-03-31 持仓市值最高的 10 个产品二级分类是哪些?

records.question: 2026 年一季度全库客户的盈亏合计是多少?(盈亏=期末总资产-期初总资产+资金流出-资金流入)
records.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260101' GROUP BY pty_id), e AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY pty_id), f AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(cash_out+tran_out+assign_out) AS o, SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in) AS i FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(e.a,0)-COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(f.o,0)-COALESCE(f.i,0)),4) AS 盈亏合计 FROM e LEFT JOIN s ON e.pty_id=s.pty_id LEFT JOIN f ON e.pty_id=f.pty_id
records.caliber_notes: 盈亏=期末资产-期初资产+资金流出-资金流入(队伍口径约定);资产=nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset;资金流=cash/tran/assign 三列。
records.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260101' GROUP BY pty_id), e AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY pty_id), f AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(cash_out+tran_out+assign_out) o, SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in) i FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(e.a,0)-COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(f.o,0)-COALESCE(f.i,0)),4) AS 盈亏合计 FROM e LEFT JOIN s ON e.pty_id=s.pty_id LEFT JOIN f ON e.pty_id=f.pty_id
records.explanation:
2026年一季度全库客户盈亏合计为 **-12,115,125.95 元**，即整体处于亏损状态。

该结果按期初（2026-01-01）与期末（2026-03-31）总资产（含净值型与理财型资产）之差，再扣除期间资金净流入计算得出，属于剔除客户出入金影响后的真实盈亏口径。

需注意，此口径仅覆盖在期末仍有资产记录的客户（以期末名单为主表关联），期间已清仓或销户的客户未纳入统计，可能对整体结果有一定影响。

records.question: 紫金理财钻石卡、男性、40 岁以上、且 2026-03-31 持有比亚迪相关产品超过 1000 的客户,2026 年一季度盈亏合计是多少?
records.gold_sql: WITH seg AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.pty_id FROM ads_cust_info_d a JOIN dim_public l ON a.cust_lvl_cd=l.code AND l.code_type_id='100' JOIN dim_public g ON a.gender_cd=g.code AND g.code_type_id='500' WHERE a.data_dt='20260531' AND l.describe='紫金理财钻石卡客户' AND g.describe='男' AND a.cust_age>40 AND a.pty_id IN (SELECT h.pty_id FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h JOIN dim_product d ON h.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE h.data_dt='20260331' AND d.prdt_name LIKE '%比亚迪%' GROUP BY h.pty_id HAVING SUM(h.hold_cnt)>1000)), s AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260101' GROUP BY pty_id), e AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY pty_id), f AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(cash_out+tran_out+assign_out) AS o, SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in) AS i FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(e.a,0)-COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(f.o,0)-COALESCE(f.i,0)),4) AS 盈亏合计 FROM seg LEFT JOIN e ON seg.pty_id=e.pty_id LEFT JOIN s ON seg.pty_id=s.pty_id LEFT JOIN f ON seg.pty_id=f.pty_id
records.caliber_notes: 客群=钻石卡(100 解码)+男(500 解码)+age>40+期末持有比亚迪>1000 份;盈亏口径同 C01。
records.sql:
WITH lvl AS (
  SELECT code FROM dim_public WHERE code_type_id='100' AND describe='紫金理财钻石卡客户'
),
gen AS (
  SELECT code FROM dim_public WHERE code_type_id='500' AND describe='男'
),
cust AS (
  SELECT c.pty_id
  FROM ads_cust_info_d c
  JOIN lvl ON c.cust_lvl_cd=lvl.code
  JOIN gen ON c.gender_cd=gen.code
  WHERE c.data_dt='20260531' AND c.cust_age>40
),
hold AS (
  SELECT h.pty_id
  FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h
  JOIN dim_product d ON h.prdt_id=d.prdt_id
  WHERE h.data_dt='20260331' AND d.prdt_name LIKE '%比亚迪%'
  GROUP BY h.pty_id
  HAVING SUM(h.hold_cnt)>1000
),
target AS (
  SELECT c.pty_id FROM cust c JOIN hold h ON c.pty_id=h.pty_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) a
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260101' GROUP BY pty_id
),
e AS (
  SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) a
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY pty_id
),
f AS (
  SELECT pty_id, SUM(cash_out+tran_out+assign_out) o, SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in) i
  FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(e.a,0)-COALESCE(s.a,0)+COALESCE(f.o,0)-COALESCE(f.i,0)),4) AS 盈亏合计,
       COUNT(*) AS 客户数
FROM target t
LEFT JOIN e ON t.pty_id=e.pty_id
LEFT JOIN s ON t.pty_id=s.pty_id
LEFT JOIN f ON t.pty_id=f.pty_id
records.explanation:
符合条件的客户只有 1 位，其在 2026 年一季度的盈亏合计为 **-661,039.39 元**，即亏损约 66.1 万元。

需要说明的是，本次统计基于以下口径：客户等级、性别、年龄按 2026-05-31 快照筛选（年龄>40 岁），持仓按 2026-03-31 快照且比亚迪相关产品份额合计超过 1000，盈亏按"（期末总资产-期初总资产）+（资金流出-资金流入）"计算，期初、期末分别取 2026-01-01 和 2026-03-31 的资产快照。由于结果仅 1 位客户，该数值即代表该客户一季度的整体盈亏，样本量小，不宜据此推断整体客群情况。

records.question: 2026 年一季度日均总资产超过 30 万、且股票交易额超过 10 万的客户有多少人?
records.gold_sql: WITH a AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset)/90.0 AS avg_aset FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id), t AS (SELECT t.pty_id, SUM(t.buy_amt+t.sell_amt) AS amt FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t JOIN dim_product d ON t.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' AND d.up_prdt_type_id='PT040000' GROUP BY t.pty_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM a JOIN t ON a.pty_id=t.pty_id WHERE a.avg_aset>300000 AND t.amt>100000
records.caliber_notes: 日均=区间合计/90(资产表 90 天);股票=up_prdt_type_id='PT040000';交易额=buy_amt+sell_amt。
records.sql:
WITH asset_agg AS (
  SELECT pty_id,
         SUM(nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset) / 90.0 AS avg_aset
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d
  WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
  GROUP BY pty_id
  HAVING SUM(nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset) / 90.0 > 300000
),
tran_agg AS (
  SELECT t.pty_id,
         SUM(t.buy_amt + t.sell_amt) AS stock_amt
  FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t
  JOIN dim_product p ON t.prdt_id = p.prdt_id
  WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
    AND p.up_prdt_type_id = 'PT040000'
  GROUP BY t.pty_id
  HAVING SUM(t.buy_amt + t.sell_amt) > 100000
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户人数
FROM asset_agg a
JOIN tran_agg b ON a.pty_id = b.pty_id
records.explanation:
2026年一季度，同时满足日均总资产超过30万元、股票交易额超过10万元的客户共有179人。

其中日均总资产按一季度90天每日总资产（含净值型与理财购买资产）加总后除以90计算，股票交易额按股票类产品的买入加卖出金额合计计算。需说明的是，客户主档信息取的是2026-05-31快照，与一季度区间存在时间差，可能对客户归属判断有轻微影响。

records.question: 2026-03-31 相对 2026-01-01,总资产增幅最大的 10 个客户是哪些?
records.gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260101' GROUP BY pty_id), e AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset) AS a FROM dws_cust_aset_d WHERE data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY pty_id) SELECT e.pty_id AS 客户号, ROUND(e.a-COALESCE(s.a,0),4) AS 资产增幅 FROM e LEFT JOIN s ON e.pty_id=s.pty_id ORDER BY 资产增幅 DESC LIMIT 10
records.caliber_notes: 增幅=期末-期初(期初缺记录按 0);资产=nm_tot_aset+fc_pur_aset;取前10。
records.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset) AS a
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d
  WHERE data_dt = '20260101'
  GROUP BY pty_id
),
e AS (
  SELECT pty_id, SUM(nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset) AS a
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d
  WHERE data_dt = '20260331'
  GROUP BY pty_id
)
SELECT e.pty_id AS 客户号,
       e.a - COALESCE(s.a, 0) AS 总资产增幅
FROM e
LEFT JOIN s ON e.pty_id = s.pty_id
ORDER BY 总资产增幅 DESC
LIMIT 10
records.explanation: 2026-03-31 相对 2026-01-01 总资产绝对增量最大的客户是 C000000000000102，增量约 606.1 万元，明显领先于其他客户。紧随其后的是 C000000000000007（约 402.1 万元）和 C000000000000010（约 264.1 万元），其余客户增量在 101 万至 194 万元之间。本次统计按"总资产 = nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset"、以 2026-01-01 为期初、2026-03-31 为期末计算绝对增量，仅取增量最大的前 10 名。

records.question: 2026 年一季度各客户等级客户的资金净流入(流入-流出)分别是多少?
records.gold_sql: WITH f AS (SELECT pty_id, SUM(cash_in+tran_in+assign_in) AS i, SUM(cash_out+tran_out+assign_out) AS o FROM dws_cust_fin_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id) SELECT p.describe AS 客户等级, ROUND(SUM(f.i-f.o),4) AS 净流入 FROM f JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON f.pty_id=a.pty_id AND a.data_dt='20260531' JOIN dim_public p ON a.cust_lvl_cd=p.code AND p.code_type_id='100' GROUP BY p.describe ORDER BY 净流入 DESC
records.caliber_notes: 净流入=流入-流出;流入/流出=cash/tran/assign 三列合计;等级经 100 解码。
records.sql:
SELECT dp.describe AS 客户等级,
       SUM(COALESCE(f.cash_in,0) + COALESCE(f.tran_in,0) + COALESCE(f.assign_in,0)
           - COALESCE(f.cash_out,0) - COALESCE(f.tran_out,0) - COALESCE(f.assign_out,0)) AS 资金净流入
FROM dws_cust_fin_d f
JOIN ads_cust_info_d c ON f.pty_id = c.pty_id
JOIN dim_public dp ON c.cust_lvl_cd = dp.code AND dp.code_type_id = '100'
WHERE f.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
GROUP BY dp.describe
ORDER BY 资金净流入 DESC
records.explanation: 2026年一季度各客户等级资金净流入均为正，其中紫金理财金卡客户最高，净流入约164.65万元；其次是银卡客户约120.60万元，钻石卡客户约102.18万元，白金卡客户约74.94万元。客户等级为"空"（未匹配到等级）的净流入约6.63万元，紫金理财卡客户最低，约5.25万元。资金净流入按流入（现金、转账、分配转入）减流出（现金、转账、分配转出）口径计算，客户等级通过客户信息表关联公共维度字典获取。

records.question: 2026 年一季度交易过招商银行相关产品、且 2026-03-31 持有中国平安相关产品的客户有多少人?
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT t.pty_id FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t JOIN dim_product d ON t.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' AND d.prdt_name LIKE '%招商银行%' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT h.pty_id FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h JOIN dim_product d ON h.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE h.data_dt='20260331' AND d.prdt_name LIKE '%中国平安%')
records.caliber_notes: 两客群交集(INTERSECT);产品按 prdt_name LIKE 匹配。
records.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.pty_id
  FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t
  JOIN dim_product p ON t.prdt_id = p.prdt_id
  WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331'
    AND p.prdt_name LIKE '%招商银行%'
),
b AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.pty_id
  FROM dwd_cust_hold_d h
  JOIN dim_product p ON h.prdt_id = p.prdt_id
  WHERE h.data_dt = '20260331'

)

FROM a
JOIN b ON a.pty_id = b.pty_id
records.explanation:
2026年一季度交易过招商银行相关产品、且在2026-03-31仍持有中国平安相关产品的客户共有 **1 人**。

说明几点：持仓按 2026-03-31 快照统计，交易时间范围实际为 20260105~20260331；产品匹配采用名称模糊匹配（含"招商银行""中国平安"字样）。该结果人数极少，可能与产品名称匹配口径较窄或同时满足两个条件的客户本身稀少有关。

records.question: 2026-01-10 至 2026-02-15,科创板产品交易额超过 25 万的客户,按营业部统计交易额?
records.gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT t.pty_id, SUM(t.buy_amt+t.sell_amt) AS amt FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t JOIN dim_product d ON t.prdt_id=d.prdt_id WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260110' AND '20260215' AND d.prdt_type_name LIKE '%科创%' GROUP BY t.pty_id HAVING SUM(t.buy_amt+t.sell_amt)>250000) SELECT b.up_org_name AS 分公司, b.org_name AS 营业部, COUNT(*) AS 客户数, ROUND(SUM(t.amt),4) AS 交易额 FROM t JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON t.pty_id=a.pty_id AND a.data_dt='20260531' JOIN dim_branch b ON a.org_id=b.org_id GROUP BY b.up_org_name, b.org_name ORDER BY 交易额 DESC
records.caliber_notes: 交易量按金额口径(队伍约定)=buy_amt+sell_amt;科创板按 prdt_type_name LIKE;区间=20260110~20260215。
records.sql:
WITH cust_tran AS (
  SELECT t.pty_id,
         SUM(t.buy_amt + t.sell_amt) AS tran_amt
  FROM dwd_cust_tran_d t
  JOIN dim_product p ON t.prdt_id = p.prdt_id
  WHERE t.data_dt BETWEEN '20260110' AND '20260215'
    AND p.prdt_type_name LIKE '%科创%'
  GROUP BY t.pty_id
  HAVING SUM(t.buy_amt + t.sell_amt) > 250000
)
SELECT b.up_org_name AS 分公司,
       b.org_name AS 营业部,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.pty_id) AS 客户数,
       SUM(c.tran_amt) AS 交易额
FROM cust_tran c
JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON c.pty_id = a.pty_id
JOIN dim_branch b ON a.org_id = b.org_id
GROUP BY b.up_org_name, b.org_name
ORDER BY 交易额 DESC
records.explanation: 2026年1月10日至2月15日期间，科创板交易额超过25万元的客户共涉及3家营业部。其中苏州分公司张家港某营业部贡献最大，有44名客户，合计交易额约1.72亿元，远超其他两家。无锡分公司某营业部仅1名客户，交易额约511万元；南京分公司某营业部同样1名客户，交易额约62.5万元。统计口径为买入金额加卖出金额，科创板按产品类型名称含"科创"匹配，营业部按分公司与营业部名称聚合。

records.question: 2026-03-31 各客户等级中总资产最高的客户及其资产是多少?
records.gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.pty_id, s.nm_tot_aset+s.fc_pur_aset AS total, p.describe AS 等级, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.describe ORDER BY s.nm_tot_aset+s.fc_pur_aset DESC) AS rn FROM dws_cust_aset_d s JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON s.pty_id=a.pty_id AND a.data_dt='20260531' JOIN dim_public p ON a.cust_lvl_cd=p.code AND p.code_type_id='100' WHERE s.data_dt='20260331') SELECT 等级, pty_id AS 客户号, ROUND(total,4) AS 总资产 FROM r WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY 总资产 DESC
records.caliber_notes: 资产取 20260331 快照;窗口按等级分组取最高。
records.sql:
WITH cust_asset AS (
  SELECT a.pty_id,
         a.nm_tot_aset + a.fc_pur_aset AS total_asset
  FROM dws_cust_aset_d a
  WHERE a.data_dt = '20260331'
),
cust_lvl AS (
  SELECT c.pty_id,
         p.describe AS lvl_name
  FROM ads_cust_info_d c
  JOIN dim_public p
    ON c.cust_lvl_cd = p.code
   AND p.code_type_id = '100'
  WHERE c.data_dt = '20260531'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT cl.lvl_name AS "客户等级",
         ca.pty_id AS "客户号",
         ca.total_asset AS "总资产",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cl.lvl_name ORDER BY ca.total_asset DESC) AS rn
  FROM cust_asset ca
  JOIN cust_lvl cl ON ca.pty_id = cl.pty_id
)
SELECT "客户等级", "客户号", "总资产"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY "客户等级" ASC, "总资产" DESC
records.explanation:
2026-03-31 各客户等级中，总资产最高的是"紫金理财钻石卡客户"，客户号 C000000000000004，总资产约 5966.22 万元，明显领先其他等级。其余等级依次为：白金卡客户 477.56 万元、金卡客户 96.17 万元、银卡客户 53.61 万元、理财卡客户 11.46 万元，另有一个等级名称为空的客户总资产仅 1.99 万元。

需说明的是，总资产按"总资产 = nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset"口径计算，客户等级名称取自 dim_public（code_type_id='100'），且每个等级只取总资产最高的一个客户。此外，资产数据取 2026-03

records.question: 2026 年一季度交易天数最多的 5 个客户是哪些?
records.gold_sql: SELECT pty_id AS 客户号, COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt) AS 交易天数 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id ORDER BY 交易天数 DESC LIMIT 5
records.caliber_notes: 交易天数=COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt);取前5。
records.sql: SELECT pty_id AS 客户号, COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt) AS 交易天数 FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id ORDER BY 交易天数 DESC LIMIT 5
records.explanation: 2026年一季度交易天数最多的5个客户分别是 C000000000000007、C000000000000026、C000000000000029、C000000000000031 和 C000000000000111，这5位客户的交易天数均为56天，并列第一。需要说明的是，本次统计按"交易天数=去重后的交易日期数"计算，且实际数据覆盖区间为2026年1月5日至3月31日，因此56天已接近该区间的上限，说明这些客户几乎每个交易日都有交易。由于5位客户天数完全相同，排名未进一步区分先后。

records.question: 2026 年一季度交易天数超过 20 天的客户有多少人?
records.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM (SELECT pty_id FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt)>20)
records.caliber_notes: 高频客户=交易天数>20;交易天数=COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt)。
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 客户人数 FROM (SELECT pty_id FROM dwd_cust_tran_d WHERE data_dt BETWEEN '20260101' AND '20260331' GROUP BY pty_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT data_dt) > 20)
records.explanation: 2026年一季度（1月1日至3月31日）共有 **201 位客户**的交易天数超过 20 天。这里的"交易天数"按客户在交易明细表中出现的不同日期去重计算，即同一客户同一天有多笔交易只算一天。

records.question: 按年龄段和客户等级交叉统计客户人数?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.describe AS 客户等级, CASE WHEN cust_age<30 THEN '30岁以下' WHEN cust_age<50 THEN '30-50岁' WHEN cust_age<60 THEN '50-60岁' ELSE '60岁以上' END AS 年龄段, COUNT(*) AS 客户数 FROM ads_cust_info_d a JOIN dim_public p ON a.cust_lvl_cd=p.code AND p.code_type_id='100' WHERE a.data_dt='20260531' GROUP BY p.describe, 年龄段 ORDER BY 客户等级, 年龄段
records.caliber_notes: 年龄分桶与 M05 同;等级经 100 解码;交叉分组。
records.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.cust_age < 30 THEN '<30' WHEN c.cust_age < 50 THEN '[30,50)' WHEN c.cust_age < 60 THEN '[50,60)' ELSE '≥60' END AS 年龄段, p.describe AS 客户等级, COUNT(c.pty_id) AS 客户人数 FROM ads_cust_info_d c LEFT JOIN dim_public p ON c.cust_lvl_cd = p.code AND p.code_type_id = '100' WHERE c.data_dt = '20260531' GROUP BY 年龄段, 客户等级 ORDER BY 年龄段 ASC, 客户等级 ASC
records.explanation: 按 2026-05-31 客户主档快照统计，本次结果中未出现 30 岁以下客户，客户集中在 [30,50)、[50,60) 和 ≥60 三个年龄段。各年龄段中，紫金理财银卡客户人数最多：[30,50) 段 14 人、[50,60) 段 65 人、≥60 段 72 人；其次为紫金理财金卡客户，分别为 9 人、40 人和 69 人。客户等级为空（未匹配到等级名称）的客户也占有一定比例，其中 [50,60) 段 28 人、≥60 段 34 人。整体看，客户人数随年龄段上升而增加，≥60 段合计约 262 人，是人数最多的年龄段。

records.question: 2026-03-31 各营业部客户总资产合计最高的 10 个营业部是哪些?
records.gold_sql: SELECT b.up_org_name AS 分公司, b.org_name AS 营业部, ROUND(SUM(s.nm_tot_aset+s.fc_pur_aset),4) AS 总资产 FROM dws_cust_aset_d s JOIN ads_cust_info_d a ON s.pty_id=a.pty_id AND a.data_dt='20260531' JOIN dim_branch b ON a.org_id=b.org_id WHERE s.data_dt='20260331' GROUP BY b.up_org_name, b.org_name ORDER BY 总资产 DESC LIMIT 10
records.caliber_notes: 资产取 20260331 快照;客户归属营业部经 org_id 上卷;取前10。
records.sql:
SELECT b.up_org_name AS 分公司, b.org_name AS 营业部名称, SUM(COALESCE(a.nm_tot_aset,0) + COALESCE(a.fc_pur_aset,0)) AS 总资产
FROM dws_cust_aset_d a
JOIN ads_cust_info_d c ON a.pty_id = c.pty_id AND c.data_dt = '20260531'
JOIN dim_branch b ON c.org_id = b.org_id
WHERE a.data_dt = '20260331'
GROUP BY b.up_org_name, b.org_name
ORDER BY 总资产 DESC
LIMIT 10
records.explanation:
2026-03-31 客户总资产最高的 10 个营业部中，苏州分公司的张家******营业部以约 5.66 亿元遥遥领先，是第二名南京******营业部（约 1346.6 万元）的 40 倍以上。其余营业部资产规模依次递减，从上海******营业部约 643.2 万元，到成都******营业部约 35.8 万元，第 10 名与第 1 名差距悬殊。整体看，头部集中度极高，前两名合计已占这 10 家营业部总资产的绝大部分。

需说明两点默认假设：总资产按 nm_tot_aset + fc_pur_aset 计算；营业部按"分公司+营业部名称"聚合。另外，客户归属机构信息取自 20260531 快照
